$description: Studio's forced-colours block. `styles/forced-colors.css` is GENERATED from this by `scripts/build-tokens.ts`; edit this file and run `bun run styles:sync`. It is emitted UNSCOPED, so each selector reaches the same elements it always did, and it is linked LAST so it still wins a specificity tie without reaching for `!important`.

.pane-tab[aria-selected=\"true\"], .tab-.$description: The pane tab's underline. `box-shadow: inset …` is gone in this mode, so the same 2px is drawn as a border on the same edge — which forced colours keep.

.notification-row--problem, .problem-row.$description: The Problems and dirty row markers, drawn with the same inset shadow and lost the same way.

.drop-target, .is-drop-target.$description: The drop target. A 3px translucent ring is invisible here twice over — shadow and alpha.

:focus-visible.$description: Keyboard focus must survive whatever a component drew it with. `Highlight` is the palette's own focus colour, and the offset puts the ring outside the control rather than over its label.

.artboard, .canvas-frame, iframe.canvas-.$description: The canvas renders the USER'S OWN DOCUMENT, and forcing colours over it would misrepresent what they are building: an author in high-contrast mode would see their site's palette replaced by the system's and have no way to tell what visitors see. `forced-color-adjust: none` opts the artboard — and only the artboard — back out. Every affordance the editor draws ON TOP of it (selection outlines, hover rules, the grid) lives outside this element and keeps the mode.

.status-dot, .severity-dot, .provenance-.$description: A dot or a bar whose whole meaning is its fill loses that meaning when every fill becomes the same system colour. A border restores the shape distinction the fill was carrying.

[disabled], [aria-disabled=\"true\"].$description: Disabled controls: forced colours map them to `GrayText`, which the browser will apply — but only if the app has not painted over it with an opacity trick. Opacity is not a colour, so it survives the mode and stacks with GrayText into something unreadable.
